prayerExcerpt.en-US: In the estimation of the wise man, "the guarding of virtue" is the most important part of the education of youth.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Na estimação do sábio, "a guarda da virtude" é a parte mais importante da educação da juventude.

meta.face: A Romano-British maiden of about nineteen with a fair, clear, lightly freckled complexion and a LONG OVAL face whose length is in a LONG LOWER FACE and a STRONG, ROUNDED chin — a smooth, moderate forehead, a straight GRECIAN nose running on in one line from the brow, LARGE, deep-set, clear grey eyes under STRONG, straight, auburn brows, smooth, lean cheeks, a LONG upper lip and a full, calm, closed mouth; thick COPPER-RED hair in two long plaits over the shoulders under the circlet; the gaze steady and protective. The two maidens behind her are small, one dark-haired and round-faced, one fair and fine-boned, their eyes lowered. Not the young, soft-oval agnes, lucy or cecilia, the short, square margaret_antioch, the long, narrow, golden-haired rosalia, the high-foreheaded euphrasia, or the convex-profiled julia_corsica.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. The card follows her usual emblems (Wikipedia; Santi e Beati: palm, arrow, crown, banner, the mantle sheltering her companions; Crivelli's panel in the lead image), the book's British origin and her flight to the Rhine near Cologne; the red hair and strong chin are ours, for a Briton.
